title: A business build waits for its content chain after the base site finishes
steps: Run the two PostgreSQL cases in wo-chain-progress.test.mjs with STEP_CHAIN_ENABLED enabled by the fixture. Finish the host provision while the site brief is applying, then settle the brief. Repeat with a live chain past the two-hour action deadline.
expect: The action stays queued while the content chain is applying even though the base provision is done.
The action completes after the chain reaches applied and retains its recorded write step.
A chain still writing beyond the two-hour action deadline keeps the action open within its maximum action window.
fence: Demo runner chainRunOpen wait and chainAliveSql deadline protection, reused from PR #522 commit 8ba53e9943023adaa78c48953e9b5e73b57ac0a1

tests: the runner marks the demo action with the chain step identifiers in order as each step starts
a chain still writing past the two hour action deadline keeps its action open until it ends
